purpose: Fixed HGB candidate, paired chunk-seed replication, common-input dependency analysis, and clean-fit noisy-OOF integration
seed42_reference: Existing developmental pilot, with nested HGB parameter selection; report separately from the fixed-parameter replications
outer_split: Existing within_wav_chunk implementation, test_fraction .25, independent RNG per source day, seed varied jointly with training and internal split
existing_models: Exact saved baseline architectures and selected parameters; 150 epochs; PCA100 version2
training_policy: clean_only; each saved clean fit predicts all seven noise conditions
model_training_seed: experiment seed + internal fold; final experiment seed + 1
noisy_weight_selection: Fit one global weight vector to equally weighted clean and six noise OOF conditions; fit labels only; no true test SNR/day/heat flux as prediction inputs

xai.source: saved seed42 fitted models and held chunks
xai.hgb_group_permutation: Saved HGB fold models on corresponding held clean and minus20 input features; shuffled feature groups, descriptive dependence
xai.common_input_interventions: Training-derived frequency baseline masks, temporal shuffle and temporal averaging on the same representative chunks for RF, Conformer, AlexNet, HGB; matched methods and controls
xai.representative_selection: Post hoc improved/worsened samples in four predefined regions; not model selection or a population estimate

status: Authorized follow-up; planned conditions fixed before new fits
